Meet Kelltic Ink

Quality isn't expensive... it's priceless

Kelltic Ink

Kelltic Ink is a modern and super clean tattoo and body piercing studio located at 182 E Wyomissing Ave in Mohnton, PA. The studio is proudly owned by Rob Kells and features talented artists like Bernie for flash work and Vee for piercing.

The shop offers a variety of services including tattoos, body piercing, and flash tattoos. Flash tattoos are available in various themes such as Halloween, floral, birth-month, and horoscope, with options for line work, shading, and color.

By appointment only

Appointments are made by messaging the shop's Facebook Page. A 50% nonrefundable deposit is due at booking and can be paid electronically.
